source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.2「夜間飛行」(2)夜間飛行のために必要な装備

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 夜間の機体灯火要件には、飛行範囲が十分照明される場合の例外がある。
evidence.tested_misconception: 夜間では環境照明に関係なく機体灯火が絶対条件である。
evidence.reasoning_path: night equipment rule -> sufficient ambient illumination -> apply exception

collision.note: MEDIUM-LOW。既存night coverageはvision sensor/human factorsが中心で、この明示的equipment exceptionは別boundary。

independent_review.rationale: 4.2 explicitly provides an exception to the aircraft-light requirement when the flight area is sufficiently illuminated; this equipment-rule boundary is not in the canonical bank.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
